dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I've read that the heroes of legend would also put their feet up around bonfires!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: In some ways, that makes a little R-and-R part of the hero's journey too, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hmm... and I don't hear anything dangerous nearby, so we can rest easy!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I wonder what'll happen if we keep going further in...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: ... I—I can do it! I've begun this journey, so I'll see it through!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: And my ancient name is "Uthabiti," after all. I can't be slowing you down! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: These books are all out of order... but I can't just go re-organizing other people's things...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Still, I just found one I really like! It's all about brave dragon-riding knights defeating a dark lord! There's nothing the hero and his dragon buddy can't do — they're amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I'm going to tell Ayo this story when I get back! I bet he'll love it so much, he'll do a little dance!
